UPW Kedzie Station Construction
Due to construction, the east end of platform 2 (south platform) at Kedzie will be closed until the end of October. Please use caution near the work area during this time. Updates will be provided.

RID train #628, scheduled to depart Blue Island/Vermont Street at 3:20 PM, will be delayed in departure due to earlier track construction. The duration of this delay is unknown. Metra will provide updates as information becomes available.

Beginning July 27 through August 27, access will be restricted to areas of the Hanover Park station due to floor repairs. It is recommended that customers check all track facings doors during normal station hours for access and use caution in work areas.

Milwaukee District North Major Track Project Affecting Midday Service Aug 3 - Oct 23

August 3 - October 23, track work to replace 4.5 miles of rail will affect midday service between Fox Lake and Lake Forest. Passengers boarding at these stations should utilize alternate Metra lines or other transportation. Visit metra.com for more info.

Beginning Wednesday, August 12 through Sunday, August 23, the Melrose Park station will close due to nearby road construction. Passengers must board trains at Maywood or Bellwood during this period.
